义项: 形容词 （英式拼写，美式 somber）色调暗淡、气氛忧郁的
形容词 (引申义) （人）神情肃穆；真题 embossed, but sombre [wallpapers] 以「压花却阴沉」写室内压抑

例句.英文: This sumptuous dining space became the setting of a spectacular falling-out between Whistler, who transformed the somber room into a golden aviary, and shipping magnate Frederick Leyland, who commissioned the work but refused to pay the full price.
例句.原书高亮: the somber room
例句.中文: 这间奢华的餐厅成了惠斯勒（Whistler）与船运巨头弗雷德里克·莱兰（Frederick Leyland）之间一场惊人决裂的舞台：惠斯勒把这间阴沉的房间改造成了一座金色鸟舍，而莱兰委托了这件作品，却拒绝支付全款。

义项: 形容词 （声音）低沉而回响饱满的（sonorous roar of the surf）
形容词 (引申义) （文辞）庄重铿锵的；n. sonority，与 shrill（尖利）相反

例句.英文: In his solitary retreat on the shore of the sea, whose mobile surface was visible through the open windows, extending outward until it mingled with the horizon, Padre Florentino was relieving the monotony by playing on his harmonium sad and melancholy tunes, to which the sonorous roar of the surf and the sighing of the treetops of the neighboring wood served as accompaniments.
例句.原书高亮: which the sonorous roar of the
例句.中文: 弗洛伦蒂诺神父独居海滨，透过敞窗可见那流动的海面一直铺展到与地平线相融；他正用簧风琴弹些哀婉的曲调排遣这份单调，而浪涛洪亮的轰鸣与邻近林间树梢的飒飒声，正好作了伴奏。

义项: 名词 意式建筑中带顶的入口平台，美式英语常指门廊（the front piazza 前廊）
名词 (引申义) （意大利城市的）广场（同 plaza）

例句.英文: … walking up and down the front piazza of his house at the rancho …
例句.原书高亮: front piazza
例句.中文: ……在他庄园宅邸的前廊上来回踱步……

义项: 名词 标准化；统一（standardization of the term / process）
[构词] standard + -ize + -ation
搭配说明: standardize / standard — v. 使标准化 / n. 标准
standardized — adj. 标准化的（standardized test）
standardization ≠ standardization of — 真题常作 a standardization of the term is called for

例句.英文: For casual usage, such haziness is permissible—we know culture when we see it—but for researchers, a standardization of the term is called for if sociology is to truly progress.
例句.原书高亮: standardization of the term
例句.中文: 对日常使用而言，这种模糊是可以接受的——文化是什么，我们一看便知——但对研究者来说，若社会学要真正进步，就需要对这个术语加以标准化。

义项: 名词 层；地层（复数 strata——真题几乎全用复数）
名词 社会阶层（the lower strata of society）
搭配说明: strata — n.（复数）——不规则复数，主谓一致常考
stratigraphy / stratify — n. 地层学 / v. 分层
stratum ≠ stratus — 后者是气象学的「层云」

例句.英文: Recent analysis of the strontium ratios in the strata of one Arctic woolly mammoth tusk in relation to the geographic distribution of strontium ratios in the environment shows the animal's range begin to expand as it reached sexual maturity, only to contract again in its final 1.5 years.
例句.原书高亮: the strontium ratios in the strata of one Arctic woolly mammoth tusk
例句.中文: 最近对一根北极猛犸象牙各层的锶比值、以及环境中锶比值的地理分布所作的分析显示，这头动物的活动范围在它达到性成熟时开始扩大，随后在其生命的最后 1.5 年里又再度收缩。

义项: 名词 批评；指责（strictures on / against）
名词 (引申义) 限制；约束（moral strictures）
名词 （管腔）狭窄——与「批评」义无关联
搭配说明: strict — adj. 严格的——同根
stricture ≠ stricture of — 真题取「批评」义，不是医学的「狭窄」
censure / critique — n. 谴责 / n. 批评——近义

例句.英文: The Times [a British newspaper], replying to some foreign strictures on the dress, looks, and behavior of the English abroad, urges that the English ideal is that everyone should be free to do and to look just as he likes.
例句.原书高亮: some foreign strictures on the dress, looks, and behavior of the English
例句.中文: 《泰晤士报》在回应外国对英国人在海外着装、外表与行为的批评时主张：英国人的理想是每个人都应当有自由去做、去呈现自己喜欢的样子。

义项: 名词 冲突；争斗（civil / domestic strife）——书面、文学语体
名词 lack of anvil and strife 没有铁砧与纷争——真题诗句
搭配说明: strive — v. 努力——与 strife 拼写相近但读音不同（/straɪv/ 与 /straɪf/）
conflict / discord — n. 冲突 / n. 不和——近义
strife ≠ striph — 无此词，注意拼写

例句.英文: He told me how calm his soul was laid By the lack of anvil and strife.
例句.原书高亮: By the lack of anvil and strife
例句.中文: 他告诉我，他的灵魂因缺少铁砧与纷争而安顿得多么平静。

例句.英文: A “When ye plead for the wrecked and fallen, / The exile from far- distant shores, / Remember that men are still wasting / Life’s crimson around your own doors.” (from “An Appeal to My Countrywomen”) B “Men may tread down the poor and lowly, / May crush them in anger and hate, / But surely the mills of God’s justice /

义项: 动词 再分；细分（be subdivided into three branches）
[构词] sub-（下、再）+ divide
搭配说明: subdivision — n. 细分；分部
subdivide ≠ subdivide into — 真题固定搭配：subdivided into A and B
dichotomize — v. 二分——近义

例句.英文: The family can be subdivided into a Zoque branch, which includes the modern language Chimalapa Zoque, and a Mixe branch, which includes the modern language North Central Mixe.
例句.原书高亮: The family can be subdivided into a Zoque branch
例句.中文: 该语系可再分为佐克语支（包括现代语言 Chimalapa Zoque）与米克斯语支（包括现代语言 North Central Mixe）。

义项: 名词 沉入水下、被水覆盖的状态或事件（submergence events）
[构词] submerge v. → submergence n.；与 submersion 近义，地质 / 生物地理阅读里解释岛屿物种存续的关键

例句.英文: The island was periodically submerged until 37 million years ago, but some researchers suggest that its current biota includes species from clades predating the split that took refuge on islands near Grande Terre during submergence events and then returned.
例句.原书高亮: was periodically submerged until 37 million
例句.中文: 该岛在 3700 万年前以前曾周期性被淹没；但一些研究者认为，岛上现生生物群中包含某些分化之前就已存在的支系——它们在淹没事件期间退避到格朗德特尔附近的岛屿，之后又回迁。

例句.英文: The island was periodically submerged until 37 million years ago, but some researchers suggest that its current biota includes species from clades predating the split that took refuge on islands near Grande Terre during submergence events and then returned.
例句.原书高亮: was periodically submerged until 37 million
例句.中文: 该岛在 3700 万年前以前曾周期性被淹没；但一些研究者认为，岛上现生生物群中包含某些分化之前就已存在的支系——它们在淹没事件期间退避到格朗德特尔附近的岛屿，之后又回迁。

义项: 形容词 地下的（subterranean networks / waters / passageways）
[构词] sub-（下）+ terr（地）+ -anean
搭配说明: subterranean ≠ terrestrial — 反义：后者是「陆地的、地球的」
terrain / territory — n. 地形 / n. 领土——同根 terr-
underground — adj. 地下的——通用近义

例句.英文: Blue holes—large marine sinkholes, like the Dahab Blue Hole in Egypt—can be hundreds of meters deep and are sometimes part of widespread subterranean networks of passageways.
例句.原书高亮: widespread subterranean networks of passageways
例句.中文: 蓝洞——如埃及达哈卜蓝洞这样的大型海洋溶洞——可深达数百米，有时是分布广泛的地下通道网络的一部分。

例句.英文: The young narrator and his friend Cico are staring into the water of a stream in rural New Mexico. The golden fish swam by gracefully, cautiously, as if testing the water after a long sleep in his subterranean waters.

义项: 名词 微妙（之处）；细微差别（subtleties in the evidence）
名词 (引申义) 敏锐；精妙（subtlety of mind / expression）
搭配说明: subtle / subtly — adj. 微妙的 / adv. 微妙地
subtlety ≠ subtleties — 真题常用复数，指「种种微妙之处」
nuance — n. 细微差别——近义

例句.英文: The establishment of urban green spaces for the abatement of fine particulate matter and other major air-pollutant concentrations is gaining public support, but urban planners must proceed with caution given subtleties in the body of evidence for the strategy’s efficacy.
例句.原书高亮: urban planners must proceed with caution given subtleties
例句.中文: 为削减细颗粒物及其他主要空气污染物浓度而建设城市绿地正赢得公众支持，但城市规划者必须谨慎行事，因为相关证据体系中存在种种微妙之处。

例句.英文: Gold, conversely, could distract from the subtleties in a painted scene.
例句.中文: 相反，金色可能分散观者对画面精微之处的注意。

义项: 动词 颠覆；暗中破坏（subvert the norms / the state）
动词 (引申义) 使（观念）动摇；反讽式地改写
搭配说明: subversion / subversive — n. 颠覆 / adj. 颠覆性的
subvert ≠ subvert to — 真题取「颠覆规范」义
undermine / overturn — v. 削弱 / v. 推翻——近义

例句.英文: Pablo Picasso famously subverted the norms of traditional painting: in his cubist paintings he refused to let his expression be constrained, fragmenting objects and figures to present multiple perspectives simultaneously.
例句.原书高亮: famously subverted the norms of traditional painting
例句.中文: 巴勃罗·毕加索以颠覆传统绘画规范而闻名：在他的立体主义画作中，他拒绝让自己的表达受到约束，把物体与形象打碎，以同时呈现多个视角。

例句.英文: It may seem counterintuitive that the sonnet—ostensibly rigid and timeworn—could accommodate such variety, but poet Carl Phillips contends that the form invites experimentation: when a genre’s conventions are as recognizable as those of the sonnet, the opportunity to subvert them is especially irresistible.
例句.中文: 十四行诗看似刻板陈旧，却能容纳如此多样的内容，似乎有违直觉；但诗人 Carl Phillips 主张，正是这一诗体吸引着实验：当一种体裁的惯例像十四行诗这样为人熟知时，颠覆它的机会就格外令人难以抗拒。

义项: 形容词 暗示的；引起联想的（suggestive of：使人想到…，表明…）
[辨析] suggestive of（表明、暗示）+ 中性义 ≠ 口语中「挑逗性的」义——SAT 只取前者
搭配说明: suggest / suggestion — v. 表明；建议 / n. 暗示；建议
suggestive ≠ suggestive of X — 真题结构：data are suggestive of X 数据表明 X
indicative / evocative — adj. 指示的 / adj. 唤起联想的——近义

例句.英文: Data collected by the Mars rover Curiosity at the Gale Crater's Murray Formation are suggestive of hydrological deposition of sediment in the distant past.
例句.原书高亮: are suggestive of hydrological deposition of sediment
例句.中文: 火星探测器好奇号在盖尔陨石坑 Murray 地层采集的数据，暗示着远古时期沉积物经由水文作用堆积而成。

例句.英文: Perhaps the most famous example is Bird in Space (1941), a tall, slender bronze sculpture that arcs upward in a manner suggestive of flight but that otherwise lacks any identifiable characteristics of a bird.
例句.中文: 最著名的例子或许是《空中的鸟》（1941）：一尊颀长的青铜雕塑以令人联想到飞翔的弧线向上延伸，除此之外却没有任何可辨识的鸟类特征。

义项: 动词 取代；替代（supplant books / a technology）
[辨析] supplant 常带「以不正当手段挤掉」的色彩，比 replace 更书面
搭配说明: supplanting — v. 现在分词——真题以此形出现
supplant ≠ supplement — 形近异义：后者是「补充」
displace / supersede — v. 取代 / v. 替代（因过时）——近义

例句.英文: Douglass believes that rather than supplanting books, technology is simply making new forms of expression possible.
例句.原书高亮: rather than supplanting books
例句.中文: 道格拉斯认为，技术并没有取代书籍，而只是让新的表达形式成为可能。

例句.英文: DOM2 spread quickly and extensively, completely supplanting other horse breeds in places like El Acequión, Spain, and Hohler Stein bei Schwabthal, Germany, by the end of the 2nd millennium BCE.
例句.中文: DOM2 传播迅速而广泛，到公元前 2 千纪末已彻底取代西班牙 El Acequión、德国 Hohler Stein bei Schwabthal 等地的其他马种。

义项: 形容词 暴露真相、显示迹象的（telltale signs of… …的明显征兆）
名词 告密者；（仪表上的）指示器；真题列举 elevated rim / circular shape 等作为撞击坑的 telltale signs

例句.英文: This structure, which the team named Nadir, exhibits all the telltale signs of a high-velocity impact crater: an elevated rim, a circular shape, a terraced floor, and a pronounced area of uplift at its center.
例句.原书高亮: all the telltale signs of a
例句.中文: 研究团队把这一构造命名为「Nadir」，它具备高速撞击坑的全部典型迹象：隆起的坑缘、近圆的外形、阶地状坑底，以及中心一处明显的隆起区。

义项: 名词 触手；触角（生物）
名词 （势力、影响的）触角：the fog extended its tentacles
搭配说明: tentacular — adj. 触手状的
tentacle ≠ tentacle of — 真题取比喻义「雾的触手」
cephalopod — n. 头足类——真题同域词

例句.英文: The fog extended its tentacles over city and river, gradually obliterating traces of familiar landscapes.
例句.原书高亮: The fog extended its tentacles over city and river
例句.中文: 雾把触手伸向城市与河流，渐渐抹去了熟悉景致的痕迹。

义项: 名词 （书面）佐证、凭据；the special testimonial of its proper voucher 指「由其可靠出处给出的专门凭据」
名词 (引申义) （今常用义）推荐信、表扬信 / 客户好评；adj. 证明性的

例句.英文: … he ought to give the world the special testimonial of its proper voucher, or else he is not just to the story …
例句.原书高亮: the special testimonial of its proper
例句.中文: ……他就该把其正当出处给出的专门凭据公之于世，否则便对不起这个故事……

例句.英文: If I judge right, ’tis the duty of an historian to set everything in its own light, and to convey matter of fact upon its legitimate authority, and no other: I mean thus, (for I would be as explicit as I can) that where a story is vouched to him with sufficient authority, he ought to give the world the special testimon
例句.中文: ……他就该把其正当出处给出的专门凭据公之于世，否则便对不起这个故事……

义项: 名词 理论家；提出理论者（literary / political / film theorist）
[构词] theory + -ist
搭配说明: theory / theoretical — n. 理论 / adj. 理论的
theorize — v. 建立理论——真题亦现
theorist ≠ therapist — 形近异义：后者是「治疗师」

例句.英文: The synthesis of novel superheavy elements, such as meitnerium (Mt), has led theorists to consider the feasibility of synthesizing all possible chemical compounds.
例句.原书高亮: has led theorists to consider the feasibility
例句.中文: 新的超重元素（如鿏 Mt）的合成，使理论家开始考虑合成所有可能化合物的可行性。

例句.英文: Some theorists have argued that historical diversity is a major driver of how diverse an ecological community eventually becomes: differences in community diversity across otherwise similar habitats, in this view, are strongly affected by the number of species living in those habitats at earlier times.
例句.中文: 一些理论家主张，历史上的多样性是生态群落最终多样性的主要驱动因素：依此观点，其他条件相似的栖息地之间群落多样性的差异，深受这些栖息地早期物种数量的影响。——2010 年，包括生物学家 Carla Cáceres 在内的一组研究者在纽约一片森林中创建了人工水池。

义项: 释义 宁静的；安详的（a tranquil scene / life）
副词提示 tranquilly adv. 平静地——真题亦现
搭配说明: tranquility / tranquillity — n. 宁静（美式 / 英式拼写）
tranquil ≠ tranquilize — 后者是动词「使镇静」
serene / placid — adj. 安详的 / adj. 平静的——近义

例句.英文: It depicts a tranquil, everyday scene (boats approaching a dock).
例句.原书高亮: a tranquil, everyday scene
例句.中文: 它描绘的是一个宁静的日常场景（小船驶近码头）。

例句.英文: It depicts a tranquil, everyday scene (a woman in a headscarf gazing out a window).
例句.原书高亮: a tranquil, everyday scene
例句.中文: 它描绘了一幕宁静的日常场景（一位戴头巾的女子凝望窗外）。《Sera toda nuestra!》（「这一切都将是我们的！」）是墨西哥裔美国艺术家 Carlos Cortéz 1977 年的彩色麻胶版画。

义项: 释义 短暂的；转瞬即逝的（a transient increase / population）
名词 n. 暂住者；流动人口
名词 （天文）暂现源：rotating radio transients 旋转射电暂现源——真题名词用法
搭配说明: transience — n. 短暂性
transient ≠ transiently — 后者是副词
ephemeral / fleeting — adj. 短暂的——近义

例句.英文: Chemically analyzing bulk rock-core samples from Australia's Mount McRae Shale, Ariel Anbar et al. found a transient but significant increase in molybdenum (Mo) at a point corresponding to roughly 2.5 billion years ago (Ga).
例句.原书高亮: a transient but significant increase in molybdenum
例句.中文: Ariel Anbar 等人对澳大利亚 Mount McRae 页岩的大块岩芯样品做化学分析后发现，在对应约25亿年前（Ga）的时间点上，钼（Mo）出现了一次短暂但显著的上升。

例句.英文: A student is researching rotating radio transients (RRATs), a subclass of pulsar stars characterized by short pulses of radio waves.
例句.中文: 一位学生正在研究旋转射电暂现源（RRAT）——脉冲星的一个子类，其特征是短促的射电波脉冲。

义项: 名词 缓缓滴流；a slow trickle of… 比喻「少量而持续地出现」
动词 (引申义) trickle down（涓滴效应）；与 flood / torrent 形成数量反差，是 SAT 阅读常见对比

例句.英文: For many decades, US movie studios produced a slow trickle of franchise movies—sequels, spin-offs, and other movies featuring familiar stories and characters.
例句.原书高亮: a slow trickle of franchise movies—sequels,
例句.中文: 几十年来，美国电影制片厂只缓慢地、零星地推出系列电影——续集、衍生片，以及其他借观众熟悉的故事与角色做文章的作品。

例句.英文: From the corners of this chip—at first drop by drop, then more freely—the sap trickled into the little dishes.

义项: 形容词 （言谈举止）不文雅、没教养的
[构词] un- + couth（古义「已知的 / 有教养的」）；现代英语几乎只用 uncouth，属「负前缀独存」的高阶词

例句.英文: … uncouth, difficult, abstract, professional, exclusive; to humanise it, to make it efficient outside the clique of the cultivated and learned …
例句.原书高亮: uncouth
例句.中文: ……粗鄙、艰深、抽象、专业化、排他的一切；使它人文化，使它能在有学养者的小圈子之外同样生效……

义项: 释义 未预见到的；意料之外的（unforeseen consequences / twists）
[构词] un- + foresee 的过去分词 foreseen
搭配说明: unforeseen ≠ unforeseen circumstances — 真题常作 unforeseen ways（无法预见的方式）
foresee / foresight — v. 预见 / n. 远见
unexpected / unanticipated — adj. 意外的——近义

例句.英文: Studying animals in a laboratory allows variables to be systematically controlled, but removing animals from their wild habitats can affect their behavior and biology in unforeseen ways.
例句.原书高亮: affect their behavior and biology in unforeseen ways
例句.中文: 在实验室里研究动物可以对变量加以系统控制，但把动物从其野生栖息地移出，会以无法预见的方式影响它们的行为与生理。

例句.英文: The narrator has just rented an apartment and is entering it for the first time. Over the years there have been many times when my destiny has delivered me unexpected moments, unforeseen twists and turns that I've had to handle on the fly as they appeared.
例句.中文: 叙述者刚租下一套公寓，正第一次踏进房门。这些年来，命运无数次把我抛入意想不到的时刻——那些我必须临场应付、不期而至的转折与变故。

义项: 名词 独特性；独一无二（associated with uniqueness）
[构词] unique + -ness
搭配说明: unique / uniquely — adj. 独特的 / adv. 独特地
uniqueness ≠ uniqueness of — 真题作 be associated with uniqueness 与独特性相关联
distinctiveness — n. 独特性——近义

例句.英文: Armin Granulo and colleagues, however, found that for products with higher symbolic value (those viewed as contributing to individual self-expression), consumers prefer products made by humans rather than by robots, likely because human-made products are more strongly associated with uniqueness.
例句.原书高亮: more strongly associated with uniqueness
例句.中文: 然而 Armin Granulo 及其同事发现，对于那些象征价值更高的产品（被视为有助于个体自我表达的产品），消费者更偏好人类制造而非机器人制造的产品，这很可能是因为人工制品与独特性之间的关联更强。

例句.英文: Sommers, Chopin emphasizes the uniqueness of Mrs.
例句.中文: 肖邦着力凸显的是索默斯太太的独特性。

义项: 形容词 未驯服的；野性的（untamed horses / wilderness）
[构词] un- + tame（驯服）+ -d
搭配说明: untamed ≠ tamed — 反义
calico (spotted) horses — 真题并列修饰：花斑（有斑点的）马
wild / feral — adj. 野生的 / adj. 野化了的——近义

例句.英文: In rural Mississippi, a man referred to as the stranger is walking among a group of untamed calico (spotted) horses that he has penned in a lot. [The horses] whipped and whirled about the lot like dizzy fish in a bowl.
例句.原书高亮: walking among a group of untamed calico (spotted) horses
例句.中文: 在密西西比乡间，一个被称为陌生人的男人正走在一群未驯服的花斑（有斑点的）马中间，那是他圈在围栏里的。[这些马]在围栏里横冲直撞、团团打转，就像鱼缸里晕头转向的鱼。

义项: 名词 骤然得势、被老派看轻的新贵（含贬义）
形容词 (引申义) 新冒头的、僭越的；真题 you crowd of upstarts and provincials 与「女王气派」形成身份反差

例句.英文: She had the air of a queen and gazed disdainfully at the whole house, as if to say, “I've come later than all of you, you crowd of upstarts and provincials, I've come later than you!” There are persons who go to the theater like the contestants in a mule-race: the last one in, wins, and we know very sensible men who would ascend the scaffold rather than enter a theater before the first act.
例句.原书高亮: crowd of upstarts and provincials, I've
例句.中文: 她一副女王气派，不屑地环视全场，仿佛在说：「我比你们所有人都到得晚，你们这帮暴发户和外乡人，我比你们来得晚！」有些人上剧院就像参加骡子赛的选手：最后进门的反倒赢了；我们也确知有些极明白的人，宁可登上断头台，也不肯在第一幕之前进剧场。

义项: 名词 （心理 / 嗅觉）某一刺激引发的正负、愉悦—不悦程度
[辨析] 化学中 valence 指「化合价」，同形异义；真题 define valence as… 是典型的定义句，常考

例句.英文: Researchers who study olfaction—the sense of smell—define valence as a person's perception of how pleasant an odor is.
例句.原书高亮: of smell—define valence as a person's
例句.中文: 研究嗅觉的学者把效价（valence）定义为：一个人对某种气味有多愉悦的感知。

例句.英文: Conventional wisdom holds that valence is culturally mediated.
例句.中文: 传统观点认为，效价受文化调节。

义项: 形容词 本地的；方言的； vernacular language / architecture
名词 方言；本国语（与拉丁语等通用语相对）
名词 vernacular artists 素人 / 民间艺术家——真题高频义
搭配说明: vernacular ≠ vernacular artists — 真题取「民间、在地」义，不是「方言」
dialect / patois — n. 方言 / n. 土话——近义
indigenous — adj. 本土的——近义，真题亦现

例句.英文: Special exhibits and similar efforts by cultural institutions to promote vernacular artists often inadvertently uphold misleading distinctions between these artists and the creators of so-called “high” art.
例句.原书高亮: vernacular artists often inadvertently
例句.中文: 因此，艺术爱好者如今得以欣赏 Nellie Mae Rowe 的画作《Rocking Chair》。——文化机构为推介乡土艺术家而举办的特展之类的举措，往往在无意中延续了这些艺术家与所谓「高雅」艺术创作者之间的误导性区隔。

例句.英文: In the last few decades, the Minneapolis Institute of Art and similar cultural institutions have worked to bring vernacular art out of obscurity.
例句.中文: 过去几十年间，明尼阿波利斯艺术博物馆及类似文化机构一直在努力让乡土艺术走出湮没无闻的境地。

义项: 名词 （尤指艺术演奏）炉火纯青的技巧
[构词] virtuoso n. 大师 → virtuosity n.；注意 virtuosity 与 virtue（美德）同源却已完全分道

例句.英文: Despite Argerich’s experience and virtuosity, she never takes for granted that she knows a piece of music.
例句.原书高亮: experience and virtuosity, she never
例句.中文: 尽管阿格里奇经验丰富、技艺精湛，她从不理所当然地认为自己已经吃透了一首曲子。

例句.英文: Although the sonnet’s intricate, rule-bound structure makes writing even one sonnet—let alone an entire series—intrinsically challenging, more recent poets from Claude McKay to Natalie Diaz have undertaken sonnet sequences, likely in part because of the opportunity the genre presents for showcasing a poet’s virtuosity

义项: 动词 vouch for 为…作保、证实；be vouched to sb with sufficient authority 凭充分权威向某人作保
[构词] voucher n. 凭证 / 保人（同句出现 voucher，可对照记忆）；与 avow（公开宣称）近源

例句.英文: His sermon is a sound of words spoken to the ear, and prepared only for present meditation, and extends no farther than the strength of memory can convey it; a book printed is a record, remaining in every man's possession, always ready to renew its acquaintance with his memory, and always ready to be produced as an authority or voucher to any reports he makes out of it, and conveys its contents for ages to come, to the eternity of mortal time, when the author is forgotten in his grave.
例句.原书高亮: voucher to any reports
例句.中文: 他的布道只是说给耳朵听的一串言语，只为当下的默想而备，所及不过记忆之力所能承载的范围；而一本印成的书则是一份记录，留在每个人手中，随时可以与他的记忆重温旧识，随时可以被拿出来，作为他据此所作任何转述的权威或凭证；它还把其内容传诸后世，直至凡人时间的尽头，那时作者早已长眠墓中、被人遗忘。

例句.英文: If I judge right, ’tis the duty of an historian to set everything in its own light, and to convey matter of fact upon its legitimate authority, and no other: I mean thus, (for I would be as explicit as I can) that where a story is vouched to him with sufficient authority, he ought to give the world the special testimon
例句.中文: 他的布道只是说给耳朵听的一串言语，只为当下的默想而备，所及不过记忆之力所能承载的范围；而一本印成的书则是一份记录，留在每个人手中，随时可以与他的记忆重温旧识，随时可以被拿出来，作为他据此所作任何转述的权威或凭证；它还把其内容传诸后世，直至凡人时间的尽头，那时作者早已长眠墓中、被人遗忘。

义项: 名词 白涂料；石灰水（a bucket of whitewash）
动词 粉饰；掩盖（whitewash a scandal / history）
[辨析] whitewash「粉饰」≠ whiteout「白化天气」≠ brainwash「洗脑」
搭配说明: whitewashed — adj. 刷白的；被粉饰的
paint / distemper — n. 油漆 / n. 水粉涂料——近义
cover-up — n. 掩饰——引申义近义

例句.英文: Tom, a child, has been told by his aunt to paint their house's fence. Tom appeared on the sidewalk with a bucket of whitewash and a long-handled brush.
例句.原书高亮: a bucket of whitewash and a long-handled brush
例句.中文: 孩子汤姆被姨妈吩咐去粉刷家里的栅栏。汤姆提着一桶白涂料和一把长柄刷子出现在人行道上。

义项: 名词 头顶正上方的天球点；引申为「顶点、全盛期」
[辨析] 与 nadir（天底 / 最低点）严格对举，两词常一起出现在文学与天文阅读中

例句.英文: The Quadrantid meteor shower has a zenithal hourly rate (ZHR) of 110, meaning that at the shower's peak, 110 meteors per hour could potentially be seen by a hypothetical observer.
例句.原书高亮: zenithal hourly rate (ZHR
例句.中文: 象限仪座流星雨的天顶每小时流星率（ZHR）为 110，即在流星雨峰值时，假想中的观测者每小时最多可能看到 110 颗流星。

义项: 名词 追随者；门徒（acolytes of a master / movement）
名词 （教会的）辅祭、侍祭
搭配说明: acolyte ≠ acquaintance — 前者带「崇敬追随」义
disciple / adherent — n. 门徒 / n. 拥护者——近义
acolytes of the group — 真题搭配：该群体的追随画手

例句.英文: That many of Hair's acolytes, including Isaac Knight, imitated the technique accounts in part for the impressionistic qualities that are now synonymous with the group's shared aesthetic.
例句.原书高亮: That many of Hair's acolytes
例句.中文: 许多追随 Hair 的画手（包括 Isaac Knight）都模仿这种技法，这在一定程度上解释了如今已成为该群体共同美学代名词的印象式特质。

义项: 副词 在空中；在高处（stay / hold aloft）
[构词] a-（在）+ loft（高处）
搭配说明: lofty / loft — adj. 高耸的 / n. 阁楼——同根
aloft ≠ aloof — 形近异义：后者是「疏远的、冷漠的」
airborne — adj. 在空中的——近义

例句.英文: Because Mars’s atmosphere is only one percent as dense as Earth’s, the air of Mars would not provide enough resistance to the rotating blades of a standard helicopter for the aircraft to stay aloft.
例句.原书高亮: for the aircraft to stay aloft
例句.中文: 由于火星大气的密度只有地球的百分之一，火星的空气无法为标准直升机的旋翼提供足够阻力，使飞行器停留在空中。

义项: 形容词 拟人的；赋予人形的（anthropomorphic elements / figures）
[构词] anthrop-（人）+ morph（形）+ -ic
搭配说明: anthropomorphism — n. 拟人化（艺术 / 宗教研究术语）
anthropology / anthropologist — n. 人类学 / n. 人类学家——同根
anthropomorphic ≠ anthropocentric — 后者是「以人类为中心的」

例句.英文: Gwion rock art from 12,000 to 14,000 years ago features elaborately ornamented anthropomorphic figures.
例句.原书高亮: anthropomorphic figures
例句.中文: 距今 12,000 至 14,000 年的 Gwion 岩画，以装饰繁复的拟人形象为特色。

义项: 名词 含水层；地下蓄水层（water entering aquifers）
[构词] aqui-（水）+ -fer（携带）
搭配说明: aquifer ≠ aqueduct — 后者是「渡槽、引水渠」
groundwater / water table — n. 地下水 / n. 地下水位——同域词
irrigation — n. 灌溉——真题同现

例句.英文: University of Texas climate scientist Geeta Persad and her colleagues simulated how the amount of water entering aquifers and the amount being used for irrigation purposes would change if this were to occur.
例句.原书高亮: the amount of water entering aquifers
例句.中文: 得克萨斯大学的气候科学家 Geeta Persad 及其同事模拟了：若发生这种情况，进入含水层的水量与用于灌溉的水量会如何变化。

义项: 副词 任意地；武断地（arbitrarily stop / assign）
形容词 arbitrary adj. 任意的；专断的
搭配说明: arbitrary — adj. 任意的；专断的——真题高频
arbitrariness — n. 任意性
arbitrarily ≠ arbitrarily chosen — 真题作「随意停下」，不是「被仲裁」

例句.英文: Some critics have found fault with the abrupt endings of Master and Commander and other books in the series, saying that they do not finish conclusively but arbitrarily stop.
例句.原书高亮: but arbitrarily stop
例句.中文: 一些批评者对《主人与指挥官》及该系列其他书的突兀结尾提出批评，说它们并非真正收束，而是随意地停了下来。

义项: 形容词 不对称的（asymmetrical orientation / wings）
[构词] a-（非）+ symmetrical
搭配说明: asymmetry — n. 不对称
symmetrical / symmetry — adj. 对称的 / n. 对称——反义
asymmetrical ≠ asymetrical — 注意拼写：sym 而非 sym

例句.英文: Many plants have leaves that are larger on one side of their long central axis than the other, a phenomenon known as asymmetrical orientation.
例句.原书高亮: a phenomenon known as asymmetrical orientation
例句.中文: 许多植物的叶片在其长中轴一侧比另一侧更大，这一现象被称为不对称取向。

义项: 名词 心理学语境：把行为或结果归因于某人或某因素（attributions of fault）
名词 艺术史与文献学语境：判定作品出自谁手（disputed attribution）

例句.英文: Research by economists Wei Feng and Jinzhe Yan indicates that the degree of linguistic abstraction in negative reviews influences how consumers perceive businesses: reviews with concrete details were more likely to result in stronger attributions of fault to companies than vague reviews were.
例句.原书高亮: in stronger attributions of fault to
例句.中文: 经济学家冯伟与严金哲的研究表明，负面评论中语言抽象程度的高低会影响消费者对企业的看法：带有具体细节的评论比含糊的评论更容易导致消费者把过错归因于企业。

义项: 形容词 非典型的；不常见的（atypical for the museum）
[构词] a-（非）+ typical
搭配说明: typical / typically — adj. 典型的 / adv. 典型地——反义
atypical ≠ atypical of — 真题作 be atypical for + 机构
uncharacteristic — adj. 非一贯的——近义

例句.英文: In its inclusion of many borrowed works, the exhibition is atypical for the Nasher Museum, which tends to curate its exhibitions around the permanent collection of contemporary art that it owns.
例句.原书高亮: the exhibition is atypical for the Nasher Museum
例句.中文: 由于纳入了大量外借作品，这次展览对纳什博物馆而言并不典型——该馆通常围绕自己拥有的当代艺术永久藏品来策划展览。

义项: 名词 文物、文件鉴定语境：确系原件而非赝品
名词 文化批评语境：未被商业化或模仿所稀释的原初品质（an authenticity that fine art cannot match）

例句.英文: At the same time, mingei, properly considered, stands apart from fine art, as its rootedness in commonplace craft traditions gives it an authenticity and accessibility that fine art, with its prizing of sophistication and innovation, cannot match.
例句.原书高亮: it an authenticity and accessibility that
例句.中文: 与此同时，若恰当看待，民艺与纯艺术是有区别的：它扎根于日常工艺传统，这赋予了它一种纯艺术所无法企及的本真性与可亲近性——纯艺术推崇精致与创新。

例句.英文: Its authenticity was confirmed, making it one of only sixty or so known works by the artist.

义项: 副词 出错地；歪斜地（go awry / plans went awry）
副词 仅作后置：something goes awry（某事物出了岔子）
搭配说明: awry ≠ awry with — 真题作 his strokes had gone awry 他的笔触走歪了
amiss / astray — adv. 不对劲 / adv. 偏离正轨——近义
askew — adv. 歪斜地——近义

例句.英文: The text describes a gathering of aspiring young artists and intellectuals. One person after another rose, and, as with an ill-balanced axe, attempted to hew out his conception of art a little more clearly, and sat down with the feeling that, for some reason which he could not grasp, his strokes had gone awry.
例句.原书高亮: his strokes had gone awry
例句.中文: 文本描述了一群有抱负的年轻艺术家与知识分子的聚会。一个接一个地站起来，像挥着一把重心失衡的斧头那样，试图把自己的艺术构想劈得更清楚些，然后带着这样一种感觉坐下：不知为何，他的每一笔都走歪了。

例句.英文: The narrator describes a gathering of artists and intellectuals. One person after another rose, and, as with an ill-balanced axe, attempted to hew out his conception of art a little more clearly, and sat down with the feeling that, for some reason which he could not grasp, his strokes had gone awry.
例句.原书高亮: his strokes had gone awry
例句.中文: 叙述者描述了一场艺术家与知识分子的聚会。人们一个接一个起身，像抡一把失衡的斧头那样，试图把自己对艺术的理解砍削得更清晰些，然后坐下，心里嘀咕不知为何斧头总是砍偏。

义项: 动词 表明；预示（bespeak confidence / sympathy）
动词 （古）要求；请求、预订
搭配说明: bespoke — adj. 定制的（bespoke tailoring）——同根的常用现代词
bespeak ≠ bespoke — 前者是动词「表明」，后者是形容词「定制的」
betoken / indicate — v. 预示 / v. 表明——近义

例句.英文: … and perhaps I am doing a bold thing to bespeak your sympathy on behalf of a man who was so very far from remarkable,—a man whose virtues were not heroic …
例句.原书高亮: to bespeak your sympathy
例句.中文: ……也许我是在做一件冒昧的事：替一个如此毫不出奇的人谋求你的同情——一个美德谈不上英勇的人……

义项: 名词 高浓度盐溶液；复数 brines 指不同成分的卤水
[构词] briny adj. 咸的；真题由「水蒸发后留下的矿物沉积」反推地外卤水，是天文 / 地球化学阅读常见推理链

例句.英文: Although studying meteorites found on Earth to infer information about brines from mineral deposits left behind when water evaporates is possible in principle, interactions with Earth’s atmosphere have likely altered or eliminated most of those deposits.
例句.原书高亮: information about brines from mineral deposits
例句.中文: 虽然原则上可以通过研究地球上发现的陨石、由水蒸发后留下的矿物沉积来推断卤水的信息，但与地球大气的相互作用很可能已经改变或抹去了其中大部分沉积。

例句.英文: Unfortunately, remote observation is not sensitive enough to provide much information about the composition or even existence of brines on such bodies.
例句.中文: 遗憾的是，远程观测的灵敏度不足以提供此类天体上盐水的成分、乃至其是否存在的信息。

义项: 名词 （船 / 飞机的）舱壁；岸墙、挡土墙（海岸工程）
[辨析] bulkhead（硬质直立岸墙）≠ riprap（抛石护岸）——真题对举
搭配说明: riprap — n. 抛石护岸——真题与之并列
bulkhead ≠ bulwark — 后者是「堡垒；保障」
seawall / revetment — n. 海堤 / n. 护坡——近义

例句.英文: To evaluate the responses of waterbirds to two types of hardening structures—riprap and bulkheads—Diann Prosser et al. surveyed waterbird communities consisting of the mute swan, the Canada goose, and 62 other species at different sites in the Chesapeake Bay on the US East Coast.
例句.原书高亮: riprap and bulkheads
例句.中文: 为了评估水鸟对两类硬化结构——抛石护岸（riprap）与直立岸墙（bulkhead）——的反应，Diann Prosser 等人在美国东海岸切萨皮克湾的不同地点调查了包含疣鼻天鹅、加拿大雁及另外62个物种在内的水鸟群落。

例句.英文: Utilizing the Index of Waterbird Community Integrity (IWCI), on which a high score corresponds to high community integrity, the researchers found that bulkheads are more strongly negatively correlated with waterbird community integrity than is riprap.
例句.中文: 利用水禽群落完整性指数（IWCI，得分越高完整性越高），研究者发现：与抛石护岸相比，挡土墙与水禽群落完整性呈更强的负相关。

义项: 动词 使浮起；支撑；鼓舞（buoy up / buoyed by hope）
名词 浮标；救生圈
搭配说明: buoyant / buoyancy — adj. 有浮力的；乐观的 / n. 浮力
buoyed up by — 被…托起、鼓舞——真题文学比喻
读音提示 — buoy 英式读 /bɔɪ/ 与 boy 同音（美式 /ˈbuːi/）；buy 读 /baɪ/，并不同音

例句.英文: We are poor plants buoyed up by the air-vessels of our own conceit: alas for us, if we get a few pinches that empty us of that windy self-subsistence!
例句.原书高亮: buoyed up by the air-vessels of our own conceit
例句.中文: 我们不过是被自己那点自负之气托浮起来的可怜植物；唉，若挨上几下挤压，把我们那点虚浮的自足之气放掉，我们就完了。

义项: 名词 停止；终止（cessation of hostilities / photosynthesis）
[构词] cess（停止，同 cease）+ -ation
搭配说明: cease — v. 停止——同根基础词
cessation ≠ cessation of — 真题作 photosynthesis cessation 光合作用停止
termination / halt — n. 终止 / n. 停止——近义

例句.英文: To assess the utility of SIF data sets for tracking processes associated with photosynthesis onset (e.g., emergence of new growth) and cessation (e.g., leaf color change), Xuan Zheng et al. calculated correlations between SIF-derived estimates of growing-season dates and length with those determined from direct observation.
例句.原书高亮: photosynthesis onset (e.g., emergence of new growth) and cessation
例句.中文: 为评估 SIF 数据集在追踪与光合作用启动（如新叶萌发）和停止（如叶片变色）相关过程方面的效用，Xuan Zheng 等人计算了由 SIF 推算的生长季起止日期与长度和直接观测所得结果之间的相关性。

义项: 释义 (引申义) （因受约束而）烦躁、恼火（chafe at / under）——由「摩擦」引申
引申义 (引申义) 摩擦；擦痛；擦热（chafe one's hands）
搭配说明: chafed — adj. 烦躁的；被擦伤的
chafe ≠ chaff — 后者是「谷壳；打趣」
fret / bridle — v. 烦躁 / v. 动怒——近义

例句.英文: The motorman chafed in his box, thinking of the drudging lot of the laboring man.
例句.原书高亮: The motorman chafed in his box
例句.中文: 司机在自己的操控间里烦躁不安，想着劳动者那苦役般的命。

义项: 名词 强制；胁迫（through coercion / by coercion）
[构词] coerce（强制）+ -ion
搭配说明: coerce / coercive — v. 强制 / adj. 强制性的
coercion ≠ coercion of — 真题作 not through coercion but through willing participation
duress / compulsion — n. 胁迫 / n. 强迫——近义

例句.英文: Through this satirical portrayal, Eggers drives home his central message: digital dystopia spreads not through coercion but through willing participation in technologies that promise social change but that encourage self-centered and moralizing behavior rather than collective action to bring about systemic improvements.
例句.原书高亮: spreads not through coercion but through willing participation
例句.中文: 通过这一讽刺性刻画，埃格斯让人明白他的核心意旨：数字反乌托邦的蔓延不是靠强制，而是靠人们心甘情愿地参与那些许诺社会变革、却助长自我中心与道德说教、而非推动集体行动以带来系统性改善的技术。

义项: 名词 自负；自大（文学 / 书面语）
名词 （玄学派诗歌的）奇想、巧思：metaphysical conceit
搭配说明: conceited — adj. 自负的——常用形容词
conceit ≠ concept — 形近异义，后者是「概念」
vanity / self-regard — n. 虚荣 / n. 自许——近义
